policy.title: Public read (bucket policy)
policy.hint: One s3:GetObject statement per prefix. Statements without an rc-public- prefix are preserved.
policy.wholeBucketWarning: Every object, including private files, becomes readable without authentication.
policy.noChange: No change: the policy already matches.
policy.confirmHint: Type {bucket} to make the whole bucket public.

lifecycle.title: Lifecycle, versioning, CORS
lifecycle.hint: One expiration rule per prefix, plus abort of incomplete multipart uploads. Existing rules without the rc- prefix are kept.
lifecycle.multipartNote: An rc-abort-incomplete-multipart rule (7 days) is always included.
lifecycle.noChange: No change: the bucket already matches.
lifecycle.corsConflictHint: This bucket already has a CORS configuration RustFS Config did not create. Type {bucket} to confirm.
lifecycle.probeOk: Probe verified: a PUT returns an Expiration header.
lifecycle.probeMissing: Probe returned no Expiration header: the rule may not be active.
lifecycle.daysInvalid: Days must be a positive integer.
